assertions.anchor: take no actions. no files, no commands, no repo changes.
assertions.why: the method skill is pure knowledge; acting is bootstrap's and handoff's job

assertions.anchor: quote the three questions and the negative list verbatim; do not soften them
assertions.why: re-anchored for #25 (was: the routing test): paraphrased questions drift toward 'use the best model to be safe', the instinct the method exists to counter

assertions.anchor: is this new ground: no precedent, pattern, or spec in the project to follow, or does it cross domains?
assertions.why: Q1 taught verbatim; 'in the project, not in the person' is what stops a new operator making everything new ground

assertions.anchor: (and, not or): 3 → pathfinder, 2 → navigator, 1 → builder, 0 → keeper
assertions.why: scoring is a count of yeses, AND not OR, mapped to four classes

assertions.anchor: irreversible (q2's yes is specifically irreversibility) and unverifiable (q3 yes) → pathfinder, whatever the count
assertions.why: the veto overrides the count: irreversible and unverifiable work is the worst case whatever else scores
passing down and passing up fall out of re-scoring; tier inertia is nobody re-scoring

assertions.anchor: ships classes and no default mapping
assertions.why: the class-to-tier mapping is the operator's; concrete model names live only in the method doc's one dated table

assertions.anchor: answer by scoring the three questions, not with a general opinion
assertions.why: re-anchored for #25 (was: answer with the routing test): 'should this go to the expensive model?' is the method's core question; an opinion in place of the score is the failure it names

assertions.anchor: switchpoints are not a fifth layer
assertions.why: W8 do-not-re-derive: switchpoints name existing rules, they are not new doctrine
the cycle order: a lane is assigned before work is handed down
the cycle order: a tier returns before the cycle closes into the ledger
handoff/handover is a deliberate homograph across the family (marketplace shared-vocabulary.md); losing the warning invites conflation
